schema.help: Count every kind of walk: to get somewhere, for leisure or for exercise.
schema.text: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk, or go in your wheelchair, for at least 10 minutes at a time?

ar.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: احسب كل أنواع المشي: للذهاب إلى مكان ما، أو للترفيه، أو لممارسة الرياضة.
ar.#In a typical week, on how many days do: في أسبوع عادي، كم يومًا تمشي، أو تتنقل بكرسيك المتحرك، لمدة 10 دقائق متواصلة على الأقل؟

de.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Zählen Sie alle Wege zu Fuß: um irgendwohin zu kommen, in der Freizeit oder zum Training.
de.#In a typical week, on how many days do: An wie vielen Tagen in einer typischen Woche gehen Sie zu Fuß oder fahren mit Ihrem Rollstuhl mindestens 10 Minuten am Stück?

en.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Count every kind of walk: to get somewhere, for leisure or for exercise.
en.#In a typical week, on how many days do: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk, or go in your wheelchair, for at least 10 minutes at a time?

fa.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: هر نوع پیاده‌روی را حساب کنید: برای رفتن به جایی، برای تفریح یا برای ورزش.
fa.#In a typical week, on how many days do: در یک هفتهٔ معمولی، چند روز دست‌کم ۱۰ دقیقه پشت سر هم پیاده‌روی می‌کنید یا با ویلچر حرکت می‌کنید؟

fr.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Comptez toutes les marches : pour aller quelque part, pour le loisir ou pour faire de l’exercice.
fr.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Au cours d’une semaine type, combien de jours marchez-vous, ou vous déplacez-vous en fauteuil roulant, pendant au moins 10 minutes d’affilée ?

hu.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Számítson bele minden gyaloglást: ha valahová megy, szabadidőben vagy edzésként.
hu.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Egy átlagos héten hány napon gyalogol, vagy közlekedik kerekesszékkel, legalább 10 percig egyhuzamban?

it.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Conta ogni tipo di camminata: per andare da qualche parte, per svago o per fare esercizio.
it.#In a typical week, on how many days do: In una settimana tipo, in quanti giorni cammini, o ti sposti in sedia a rotelle, per almeno 10 minuti di fila?

tr.#Count every kind of walk: to get somewh: Her türlü yürüyüşü sayın: bir yere gitmek, boş zaman veya egzersiz için.
tr.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Tipik bir haftada kaç gün en az 10 dakika aralıksız yürüyor ya da tekerlekli sandalyenizle ilerliyorsunuz?
